q.g: In this quest you have to find and extract three military documents. They are all located in the command part of the underground bunker system on Reserve. One is located on a desk in the glassed-in command room that is accessible from the room that has the D-2 power lever. One is located in the room that is connected to the glassed-in command room in the bottom compartment of a shelf in the corner of the room. One is located in a wardrobe that can be found in the large central hallway.
